items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: there was a social science teacher, Arnold Wright, who was like a second father to me.

ctx.x: I thought you were already going there and got involved in the Collegians. The Collegians went there. The band --

Yeah. They imported the band from Chicago, an organized band, and there was a social science teacher, Arnold Wright, who was like a second father to me. He had a lot to do with the Alabama State Collegians, with the -- what's his name? Erskine Hawkins.
